Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection I1 for GE frame 5, Air Cooled 
 Generator, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in 
 the title block. The first draft initiated by eng Saleh and tested at 
 13 June 02 on generator unit 6 at Talkha GT PS, EDEPC and approved by Sector 
 Manager of Talkha PS eng. Mostafa Abd El Hameed Aalam.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
